claims.claim: The study reports exactly three valid prospectively frozen unresolved scientific questions.
claims.scope: three non-random cases in one programme

claims.claim: Both instruments agreed on the primary diagnosis and primary experiment in every valid case.
Case A was aligned on diagnosis and experiment under its frozen deferred map.
claims.scope: registered finite regime and support-two outcomes

claims.claim: Case B used 53 exact rows and found zero unrestricted-versus-support-two gaps.
claims.scope: frozen panel only; sharpness remains open

claims.claim: Case C exhaustively checked 39,489 declared low-order cases and found zero original-predicate/label mismatches.
claims.scope: 729 ordered one-object and 38,760 reorder-quotiented two-object cases; not all sizes

claims.claim: In case C, the instruments agreed but both diagnoses were misaligned, while both selected experiments were aligned.
claims.scope: single explicit counterexample; no prevalence inference

claims.claim: Two candidate questions were retired as contaminated before instrument freeze and were not retrospectively scored.
Two known malformed-success and recoverability defects remain accepted fail-closed limitations, were not repaired between cases and did not trigger in the valid cases.
claims.scope: frozen instrument version; no fault-tolerance claim

claims.claim: The case series does not estimate reliability, calibration, population rates, predictive validity, statistical independence or generalization.
